entries.234ed83b95cbddd9: Valve and Remote Control Device Manufacturing and Sales Business
entries.2affc0e19d02be90: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells automatic control valves, butterfly valves and remote control devices for ships, power plants and other uses. The company, together with two consolidated subsidiaries and three unconsolidated subsidiaries, forms the group, and it purchases products from two consolidated subsidiaries in South Korea (ACE VALVE CO., LTD. and NAKAKITA KOREA CO., LTD., both located in Gimhae City, South Korea). By product type, revenue from external customers is largest for butterfly valves, followed by automatic control valves and remote control devices, in that order.
